citation: Hathaway, Joshua. Chicago with the School Section, Wabansia, and Kinzie's Addition. 1834.
author: Joshua Hathaway
repository: Library of Congress, Geography and Map Division (also Newberry Library, Graff 1817)
locator: LOC call no. G4104.C6G4 1820 .H2; JP2 6536 x 9318 px
note: The extent envelope: the original plat PLUS the School Section, Wabansia and Kinzie's Addition — the five parcels that roughly doubled the platted area, and the correct envelope for an 1835 model. Commissioned by John H. Kinzie to facilitate lot sales. CORRECTION, verified 2026-08-09 at native LOC resolution: this map does NOT show buildings. The widely repeated claim (carried into this project's own brief) that 'small rectangles denote individual buildings, bold rectangles fully built-up blocks' is FALSE for this sheet. Inspected at the forks and across the built-up South Water blocks 17-21 at full resolution, it is a pure cadastral lot plat: block outlines, numbered lots 1-8, street names and survey bearings, and nothing else. What it is genuinely excellent for is STREET AND LOT GEOMETRY — exact block dimensions and lot subdivision, which lets a building documented at a named corner be placed precisely on that corner. It cannot supply footprints. CATALOGING TRAP: the Library of Congress dates this '[1820?]' and the call number encodes 1820; Hathaway was born in 1810. Record the discrepancy, do not silently correct it.
access_notes: Use the LOC JP2/IIIF (tile.loc.gov, master TIFF ~174 MB), NOT the Newberry surrogate — the Newberry published only a single 1.9 MB JPEG to Internet Archive (archive.org/details/nby_157756), which is insufficient for warping.
